messages:
alex: Quick sync — we need to finalize how quota tiers map to enforcement policies (free/pro/enterprise). TL;DR: per-org limits, per-key bursts, and UI visibility.

maria: +1. want to make burst behavior clear in the console. free should have very tight bursts, pro more flexible, enterprise customizable.

sam: Technical constraints: our edge rate limiter uses token-bucket right now. We can do two-tier enforcement: global org bucket + per-key bucket. Burst tokens can be minted based on plan.

jamie: Example proposal: free = 60 req/min steady with 10 req burst; pro = 600 req/min with 100 burst; enterprise = 5000 req/min with configurable burst and SLO-backed overrides. Thoughts?

alex: That matches product intent. Need to call out cost controls: pro burst should still throttle long-running streaming tokens to protect GPU cost. Maybe different token weights for streaming vs non-streaming.

maria: Agree. Also add a soft-limit warning channel in the console (and telemetry) that shows "approaching burst" so customers see why calls start failing.

sam: Implementation note: token weights -> streaming chunk = 10 tokens per chunk, non-streaming = 1. We'll implement in limiter: bucket.consume(tokens, now). If bucket empty -> 429.

sam: Code-ish snippet that would live in limiter:
``` 
// pseudo
const plan = getPlan(orgId)
const bucket = getBuckets(orgId, apiKey)
const cost = isStreaming ? STREAM_WEIGHT : 1
if (!bucket.tryConsume(cost)) {
  emitMetric('rate_limit.hit')
  return 429
}
```

taylor: For console mapping, we should show both "Rate limit (steady)" and "Burst capacity" on the plan page + per-key breakdown in the keys table. UI copy should say "burst is temporary and measured over X seconds".

jamie: Ops question: how do we handle rollover for enterprise during spikes? Allow temporary burst above committed only when autoscale available and logged for billing. Otherwise fallback to pro compatible model.

alex: Decision points to confirm:
1) exact numbers for free/pro baseline & default burst (maria + product)
2) streaming token weight (sam to prototype)
3) console telemetry: soft-limit alerts, per-key history for last 24h (taylor)
4) enterprise override path (jamie + eng-sre)

maria: I'll draft plan mapping doc and pricing table copy. Putting rough numbers: free 60/min (10 burst), pro 600/min (150 burst), enterprise 5k/min (500 burst default) but adjustable. Will circulate.

quota-bot: [automated] note: existing customers with custom limits will not be changed by the rollout. New defaults apply to new orgs only.

alex: Ok good. Next steps: maria to share PR for product copy by EOD tomorrow; sam to spike limiter change and run load test; taylor to mock UI row. We'll sync again after artifacts. :thumbsup:
